name: DABstep (Data Agent Benchmark for Multi-step Reasoning)
why_it_matters: Mirrors the core newsroom workflow of ingesting messy data, running analysis, and producing a defensible written answer.
task_shape: Agents receive real-world data files plus domain documentation and must explore, code, and reason across multiple steps to produce a precise factoid or narrative answer to an analyst-style question.
signals: Built from real business data tasks requiring both code and contextual document reading, closely echoing data journalism work.
Answers are graded by exact-match style checks, which can penalize correct but differently phrased narrative outputs.
